svg.aria-label: The JFrog Platform top bar, decoded. One: the nine-dot launcher opens a drawer of subscriptions and sites, for admins. Two: the site name shows which site you are on. Three: Platform is the everyday menu. Four: Administration is the set-up menu. Five: the project list narrows the screen to one project. Six: search. Seven: Ask AI. Eight: the user icon for your profile and tokens.
